body:
ESC-884 has blown up since yesterday and I need everything buttoned up before the support standup tomorrow morning. My inbox is a mess — there are threads about the customer's return, carrier issues, finance sign-offs, VIP queue pings, plus some older stuff and random noise that probably has nothing to do with this case. Thanks,
Dana

subject: How retailers reduce return fraud
snippet: This week in return fraud: serial number swapping remains the top scheme, with bad actors returning lower-value units bearing doctored serial labels. P
body: This week in return fraud: serial number swapping remains the top scheme, with bad actors returning lower-value units bearing doctored serial labels. Photo manipulation is on the rise — inspect EXIF metadata and compare timestamps. Carrier claim abuse rounds out the top three, where fraudsters file duplicate claims across multiple logistics partners. Retailers using automated serial verification at the dock report a 37% drop in successful swap fraud.
